outcome: Activation status of LDG and normal-density granulocytes
cohort: The study included 12 women with SLE pregnancies and 10 healthy control pregnancies, from whom peripheral blood, maternal-derived intervillous blood, and placentas were collected.
finding: Women with SLE pregnancies had significantly higher proportions of activated low-density granulocytes in blood, increased levels of chemokines CXCL8 and CXCL1 in intervillous blood, detectable IFNalpha, and more frequent histological chorioamnionitis in placentas compared to healthy pregnancies.
